name: com.tenkiv.tekdaqc.android.application.service.TekdaqcLocatorManager$LocatorService
description: When TenKiv's locator manager starts or binds this service, it searches for TekDAQC boards at the requested interval and reports discovery changes to the app.
disableEffect: Disabling it stops this version of the app's TekDAQC board search and discovery updates.
